svg.aria-label: What I do: AI agents and automation. Agents that take real actions, in PepNote, in coding tools and for clients. Native iPhone apps. Two complete iPhone apps, CaloMatic and PepNote, built on my own. Backends and billing. The accounts, data and payments both apps run on. Models and data. Training and running AI models, including the calorie coach inside CaloMatic. Product design. I design what I build: both apps, their icons and this profile.
